name: colors
description: Color utility module providing 22 predefined RGB constants, gradient generation, rainbow sequences, brightness manipulation, and value-to-color mapping. Designed for NeoPixel and RGB LED projects.

constants.VOLUME_BAR: [[BLUE, CYAN, TEAL, GREEN, LIME, YELLOW, ORANGE, RED] — cool-to-warm gradient]

functions.name: is_qualified_color
functions.description: Check if color is valid (r,g,b) tuple with each component 0-255

functions.name: generate_random_color
functions.description: Return a random color from COLORS list

functions.name: generate_random_rgb
functions.description: Return random (r, g, b) with each component in [min_val, max_val]

functions.name: generate_gradient_colors

parameters.name: steps
parameters.description: Number of colors to generate (positive integer)

parameters.name: mid_color
parameters.description: Optional middle color for two-stage gradient

functions.description: Generate linearly-interpolated color gradient. With mid_color, creates two-stage gradient through middle point.

functions.name: generate_rainbow_colors
functions.description: Generate n rainbow colors by interpolating between RAINBOW keypoints

functions.name: offset_colors

parameters.name: steps
parameters.description: Positive: shift right; negative: shift left

functions.description: Rotate a color list by `steps` positions (modular shift)

functions.name: map_value_to_color
functions.description: Map a numeric value to a color from gradient_colors list. Clamps to boundaries if value out of range.

functions.name: dim_color
functions.description: Darken color by factor (multiply each channel)

functions.name: brighten_color
functions.description: Brighten color toward white by factor

functions.name: scale_color
functions.description: Scale color brightness by multiplication (clamped to 255)

functions.name: is_same_color
functions.description: Check if two colors are exactly equal (component-wise)

example:
from colors import RED, BLUE, generate_gradient_colors, map_value_to_color

gradient = generate_gradient_colors(RED, BLUE, steps=10)
mapped = map_value_to_color(50, 0, 100, gradient)
test_method: N/A — colors is a function module, no interactive hardware to test
esp32_notes: All colors are (r, g, b) tuples with int components 0-255 — match NeoPixel format
No I/O performed — pure compute module, safe in ISR
Memory: storing 100 gradient colors uses ~600 bytes
differences_from_standard_mp: Standard MicroPython has no color module — NovaMP adds this utility
